blocks.text: The most common skin cancers may be categorized into 2 major groups: melanoma and nonmelanoma skin cancers. The latter group consists primarily of basal cell carcinomas and squamous cell carcinomas.

blocks.text: These tumors are rarely fatal, but are considered to be fast-growing tumors that, if neglected, may be locally and functionally destructive. They are common in person living with albinism and xeroderma pigmentosum.
